prompt: Implement the unfinished `Vcf.OperationsForLogs` PowerShell module in `src/`. This integration targets VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 (called log management only in VCF 9.1), so use the pinned 9.0 contract in `docs/contract.json` and do not substitute a 9.1 contract. Keep `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops` version `13.4.0.24798382` as the external PowerCLI prerequisite declared by the module manifest; do not vendor any VMware module. Export `Invoke-VcfLogsUpgrade` with the supplied signature. It must start the URL-based PAK upgrade, accept the returned version's EULA, and then poll that version until `clusterStatus` is a terminal `Complete`, `Cancelled`, or `Failed` value, returning the final status object. Build each request from bound values so unset optional values are omitted, send the bearer session ID and request JSON on every request, preserve the contract's JSON property names, send the write bodies as `application/json`, and do not send a body or content type on polling GETs. Poll without an attempt ceiling, using `PollIntervalMilliseconds` between nonterminal responses. The provided verifier runs only against the loopback mock and must not contact a live VMware endpoint. Run `python3 tests/verify.py` to check the implementation.
